arguments.text: 8000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Pacer sets effort; I watch for weed (speed per pod watt drops, push_local well below push_along -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod power vs boat-model power and heart rate disagree -> set pod_gain), course/radio changes (set_race_distance, tell), and check critical power against heart rate after the start settles (min 3-10). Compare legs in same direction to spot drag/drift. Use few cues; keep 3+ in reserve for the end.

arguments.text: 4.0 min: settled at shaft ~186 W (pod CP 184), boat 130 W (CP 123). HR 166->168->169 over min 2-4, still settling after hard start. Pod reserve 49%, boat 40%. Pod/boat power ratio ~1.42 vs test 1.50. push_local -0.02 vs push_along -0.08 (fit lags). Check HR trend min 4-8 at ~CP: if keeps climbing, CP is high.

arguments.text: 7.3 min: measure 270-395 s (leg 1 out, steady): pod 187 W, boat 128 W, GPS 3.12, water 3.18, rate 59, HR 169.2, HR trend +0.38+-0.28 bpm/min (flat). Paddler 7/10 steady feels fine. => pod CP ~184 looks about right or a bit low. Boat reserve (29%) drains faster than pod (45%): boat power likely overstated by current-fit lag (push_along -0.12 vs local -0.04 on leg 1). Pacer easing on boat numbers (cues 111 s, 399 s). Plan: two-direction hull fit at ~560 s (leg1 270-395 vs leg2 ~450-560) then maybe correct boat CP/beliefs.
